## Enabling Industries to be more sustainable and resource-efficient

We help industries become more productive, efficient and sustainable so they can outperform, or as
we say – ‘outrun’.

industries

Building for tomorrow

The $13 trillion global buildings and construction industry faces challenges like high emissions,
material and labor shortages, and low productivity, but ABB's electrification and automation
technologies offer solutions to enhance sustainability, efficiency, and performance.

ABB helps you reduce waste and lower emissions

Scaling data centers

From cloud environments to gigawatt-scale AI, we work side by side with customers and partners to
deliver the world’s most advanced data centers.

One in four data centers run on ABB technology

Feeding a growing world

The global food and beverage industry faces growing demands; to increase output while navigating
supply vulnerabilities, regulations, and resource constraints. In the food and drink sector ABB
provides integrated automation, electrification, and digital technologies that help industries
outperform.

Enabling the food and beverage industry to outperform

Decarbonizing shipping

ABB are paving the way to a zero-emission marine industry, providing greater efficiency and
reliability to shipowners, and preparing vessels to meet the demands of tomorrow.

Driving the evolution of sustainable shipping

Energy transition partner

ABB is making a world of difference by enabling safe, smart and sustainable operations with
integrated solutions that digitalize, automate & electrify the oil and gas industry.

Smart, sustainable operations for oil and gas

The future of energy

Utilities face immense pressure to provide safe, reliable energy while reducing the Levelized Cost
of Electricity. From maintaining grid stability to securing against cyberattacks, power-generation
companies need adaptable, integrated solutions

Shaping tomorrow's power generation landscape

## A global technology leader in electrification and automation

By connecting our engineering and digitalization expertise, we help industries run at high
performance, while becoming more efficient, productive and sustainable so they outperform.

### Electrification

The world needs more power with lower emissions. As a global technology leader in electrical
distribution and management, we bring electrification solutions together to accelerate
decarbonization and increase energy efficiency.

### Automation

ABB's Process Automation business offers a broad range of solutions for process and hybrid
industries, including industry-specific integrated automation, electrification and digital
solutions, control technologies, software and advanced services, as well as measurement & analytics,
and marine offerings.

### Motors and Drives

ABB, global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and
sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy
efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies.

### Power Conversion and Control

ABB power converters and controllers help customers to generate and use energy efficiently. They are
designed for reliable operation even under the most demanding conditions, and for low life cycle
costs.

### Renewable Power

At the heart of the energy transition lies the expansion and reliable integration of solar, wind,
hydro, geothermal and other non-fossil energy sources. Building smarter, more adaptable energy
infrastructure can help leverage the immense potential of renewables.

### Robotics

ABB Robotics is one of the world’s leading robotics suppliers, offering a comprehensive and
integrated portfolio that includes industrial and collaborative robots, autonomous mobile robots
(AMRs), controllers, application solutions, services, and equipment.

## Latest news

## Leading with technology

### The SACE Emax 3

Discover the ultimate evolution in air circuit breaker technology. ABB SACE Emax 3 is engineered to
make electrical distribution systems more adaptive, reliable and secure.

### ABB Genix™ Industrial IoT and AI Suite

Unlock the power of industrial data and AI with ABB Genix IIoT and AI Suite. Bring together domain
expertise with AI and advanced analytics to transform operations, optimize assets and processes,
improve energy efficiency, and accelerate sustainability goals.

### GoFa with Ultra Accuracy

Find out how ABB’s Ultra Accuracy feature makes GoFa the most path-accurate cobot on the market,
offering 10 times greater precision than other cobots, setting a new standard in accuracy. This
superior performance meets the demands of applications where exact positioning is crucial for
maintaining product quality and operational efficiency. 

### Azipod® electric propulsion

From its creation three decades ago to its market leading position in global shipping today, Azipod®
propulsion has revolutionized marine transport

# Broad Industry and Customer Support

[Advanced Technical Services was founded in 1981 as D&B Auto Radio Inc., an automotive electronics
repair center for General Motors, Ford and Chrysler. Over the next 15 years, the company grew to be
one of the largest automotive electronics repair centers in the country repairing over 30,000
electronic products per month.][106]

[About][107]

# Outsourcing for Greater ROI

[Since 1981 Advanced Technical Services has provided reverse logistics, remanufacturing, repair and
a][108][ssembly solutions][109][ to customers worldwide. Our clients trust us to help manage their
supply chain and provide them with high-quality, lower-cost programs and solutions.][110]

[Services][111]

##### INDUSTRIES SERVICED

## Broad based electronics industry experience

Our core competencies as an electronics remanufacturing company have grown with the expansion of
technology and electronics in everyday life. We’ve come a long way from solely being an OEM radio
repair center and have dedicated teams to service our customers’ unique needs.

[LEARN MORE >>][112]

##### SERVICES OFFERED

## Leading providers of OEM support solutions

At Advanced Technical Services, we have one goal: to make the lives of our OEM customers better.
From automotive remanufacturing to fleet installation services, our offerings provide each of our
customers with customizable solutions to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of their supply
chain while reducing overall cost.

[LEARN MORE >>][113]

##### PRODUCTS SUPPORTED

## No electronic remanufacturing program is out of our reach

We have a saying at Advanced Technical Services: “if it has a circuit board, we can fix it.” And
while that’s not necessarily the greatest tagline, it gets the message across. We create customized
OEM remanufacturing and repair solutions for anything with electronic components.

[LEARN MORE >>][114]

##### COMPANY

## A midsize company with a big market presence

At ATS, we’re not just a place of work, we’re a family. Being an owner-operated business allows us
to put our staff members first, which has provided us with an incredibly dedicated workforce. In
fact, our average employee has been with us for over 20 years … a stat we’re very proud of!

# Electric Vehicle Charging Station Remanufacturing

We’ve applied our knowledge of high-power rectifier telecom repair to become one of the world’s
first EV charger remanufacturing companies. From lower-powered Level 1 and Level 2 chargers to
fast-charging Level 3 chargers, we create the right program for our EV OEM customers’ needs.

[LEARN MORE >>][101]

# OEM Support Services

The ATS OEM support team is committed to delivering the highest level of customer satisfaction
throughout the repair process and offers a variety of [remanufacturing, repair, and related
solutions][102] designed to support the needs of the OEM and its customers.

[OEM Support Services][103]

# Customized Solutions

Advanced Technical Services pursues and maintains Quality Certifications in order to deliver on our
commitment to Total Customer Satisfaction. ATS employees possess the skills, training and
instruction to complete your project on time and to specifications.

[Certifications][104]

# Electric Vehicle Drivetrain Remanufacturing

As a veteran in the automotive reman and repair industry, we’re uniquely positioned to pave the way
as an EV drivetrain remanufacturing company. We’ve done the research and built out our facilities
keeping the high-power requirements of our EV OEM customers in mind.

[LEARN MORE >>][105]

# Broad Industry and Customer Support

[Advanced Technical Services was founded in 1981 as D&B Auto Radio Inc., an automotive electronics
repair center for General Motors, Ford and Chrysler. Over the next 15 years, the company grew to be
one of the largest automotive electronics repair centers in the country repairing over 30,000
electronic products per month.][106]

[About][107]

# Outsourcing for Greater ROI

[Since 1981 Advanced Technical Services has provided reverse logistics, remanufacturing, repair and
a][108][ssembly solutions][109][ to customers worldwide. Our clients trust us to help manage their
supply chain and provide them with high-quality, lower-cost programs and solutions.][110]

[Services][111]

##### INDUSTRIES SERVICED

## Broad based electronics industry experience

Our core competencies as an electronics remanufacturing company have grown with the expansion of
technology and electronics in everyday life. We’ve come a long way from solely being an OEM radio
repair center and have dedicated teams to service our customers’ unique needs.

[LEARN MORE >>][112]

##### SERVICES OFFERED

## Leading providers of OEM support solutions

At Advanced Technical Services, we have one goal: to make the lives of our OEM customers better.
From automotive remanufacturing to fleet installation services, our offerings provide each of our
customers with customizable solutions to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of their supply
chain while reducing overall cost.

[LEARN MORE >>][113]

##### PRODUCTS SUPPORTED

## No electronic remanufacturing program is out of our reach

We have a saying at Advanced Technical Services: “if it has a circuit board, we can fix it.” And
while that’s not necessarily the greatest tagline, it gets the message across. We create customized
OEM remanufacturing and repair solutions for anything with electronic components.

[LEARN MORE >>][114]

##### COMPANY

## A midsize company with a big market presence

At ATS, we’re not just a place of work, we’re a family. Being an owner-operated business allows us
to put our staff members first, which has provided us with an incredibly dedicated workforce. In
fact, our average employee has been with us for over 20 years … a stat we’re very proud of!

# ELECTRONIC DEVICES, INC.

Designer and manufacturer of an extensive selection of bridges, low and high voltage rectifiers,
high voltage fast recovery diodes, and high voltage assemblies. Available in a wide range of voltage
and current ratings, recovery times, case configurations, and terminations. Each is designed with
special characteristics to match a wide array of specific applications.

[ See Products ][32]
[ Contact Sales ][33]

## [Bridges][34]

Single phase and 3 phase bridges, standard, fast, or ultra-fast recovery speeds, and printed circuit
or chassis mounts. Available in a wide range of current and voltage ratings.

[ See Bridges → ][35]

## [High Voltage Assemblies][36]

Catalog and custom designed rectifier assemblies covering a broad spectrum of voltages (up to
250,000 volts), currents (up to 25 amperes), and package styles.

[ See HVAs → ][37]

## [Rectifier Diodes ][38]

Axial Lead diodes with standard, fast, or Ultra-fast recovery speeds. Current ratings from 5
milliamperes to 6 amperes. 50 Volts to 30,000 Volts.


[ See Diodes → ][39]

## [Night Vision & Special Devices][40]

Ultra-low leakage, sub-miniature high voltage night vision diodes and arrays. And other specialized
application devices.

[ SEE More → ][41]

## Custom Devices

## Need something custom?

EDI is ready to custom build completely new devices or alter the design of current product lines to
meet your specifications.

EDI has frequently introduced new, innovative designs into the industry:
* Ultra-fast recovery bridges, rectifiers, & surface mount devices as low as 50 nano-seconds.
* Ultrasonically cut round chips in all our diodes that reduce corona leakage and increase
  reliability.
* Patented MINISEL high voltage focus rectifiers used in TV’s.
* High voltage multipliers in TV’s and microwave ovens.
* **Night vision** diodes and diode arrays used in military night vision rifle sights and aviator
  goggles.
  * Ultra-low leakage & sub-miniature


[EDI Logo]

## Electronic Devices Inc.

Specialists in manufacturing rectifiers since 1951, operates out of three locations:

### EDI NY

**Yonkers, New York**

Yonkers is our corporate headquarters and the center of our operations. All administration,
engineering, marketing, and finance are controlled from this location. Our manufacturing operations
in Yonkers include silicon processing, acid operations, quality control, engineering, and minor
packaging and shipping.

[Flag of China]

[April 6, 2020May 26, 2024][74]
[[best electrical engineering books]][75]

If you’re looking to learn all about electronics and electrical engineering – you’ve come to the
right place.

Electrical4U is dedicated to the teaching and sharing of all things related to electrical and
electronics engineering.

To learn about basic Electrical Engineering, check out our articles on [Voltage][76], [Current][77],
[Transformers][78], [Single Phase Transformers][79], [Step Down Transformers][80], [Step Up
Transformers][81], [Alternators][82], [DC Motors][83], [Induction Motors][84], [Star Delta
Starter][85], [Lenz’s law][86], [Faraday’s law][87], and [DOL Starters][88]. We also review the

[RTDs][91], [Diodes][92], [Thermistors][93], [High Pass Filters][94], [Active Low Pass Filters][95],

To learn more about [Control Engineering][102], check out our articles on [Control Systems][103],
[Programmable Logic Controllers][104] (PLCs), [SCADA Systems][105], [Nyquist Plot][106], and [Bode
Plot][107].

We also explore closely related physics topics such as the [Schrodinger Wave Equation][108], [Biot
Savart Law][109], and the [Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle][110].

And if you’re not sure where to start when it comes to learning electrical engineering and
increasing your electrical knowledge, [join our (free) email list][111].

][112]Need help preparing for your exams? **We have over 5000 electrical and electronics engineering

][113]We discuss various types of electric motors including DC Motors, Induction Motors, Synchronous

and testing of electric motors. This category is a collection of electrical knowledge about all
things related to electric motors.

include a number of trade tools that will increase your company's exposure to wholesale buyers

## Industry Field

### Industry Field

As a professional electronic components distributor, FTC supports industries worldwide in addressing
challenges like shortages and the growing demand for obsolete electronic components.

Our reliable distribution of electronic components helps drive innovation across sectors. Whether in
Automotive & EV, Automation, or Artificial Intelligence, essential electronics components — from
semiconductors to capacitors — are fundamental to progress.

We are not just an electronic part supplier; we also partner with electronics components
distributors and wholesalers. Our presence extends globally, with support for customers in the USA,
Singapore, and other regions. This makes FTC a trusted electronics components distributor in USA and
a reliable partner for electronic components Singapore.

Looking forward, we will strengthen our role as a premier electronics components distributor,
enhancing services for the evolving needs of global industries.

## Industry Field

### Industry Field

As a professional electronic components distributor, FTC supports industries worldwide in addressing
challenges like shortages and the growing demand for obsolete electronic components.

Our reliable distribution of electronic components helps drive innovation across sectors. Whether in
Automotive & EV, Automation, or Artificial Intelligence, essential electronics components — from
semiconductors to capacitors — are fundamental to progress.

We are not just an electronic part supplier; we also partner with electronics components
distributors and wholesalers. Our presence extends globally, with support for customers in the USA,
Singapore, and other regions. This makes FTC a trusted electronics components distributor in USA and
a reliable partner for electronic components Singapore.

Looking forward, we will strengthen our role as a premier electronics components distributor,
enhancing services for the evolving needs of global industries.

### Standards

[See All][185]
[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

Ensure your electronic systems are safeguarded against harmful voltage spikes and transient surges
with MCC’s reliable TVS diodes. Dive deeper into our comprehensive guide to understand the critical
role of TVS diodes and how they can enhance the performance and longevity of your devices.

Ensure stable and efficient AC to DC conversion in your designs with MCC’s reliable rectifier
diodes. Dive into our comprehensive guide to understand the essential role rectifiers play in power
systems and how they support performance, protection, and long-term reliability across a wide range
of applications.

## 40V MOSFET Functions & Features

Ensure your electronic systems run efficiently with 40V MOSFETs, essential for automotive
applications and power management. Check out our guide to discover their role in motor drives, DC-DC
converters, and battery management systems, and learn how their low on-resistance and high current
capacity enhance efficiency and stability.

Ensure your circuits stay stable and protected with Zener diodes, essential for voltage regulation
and overvoltage clamping. Check out our guide to learn how they maintain fixed reference rails,
safeguard inputs, and support signal conditioning, with clear selection tips on Vz, current, power,
package, and temperature, plus MCC’s precision, high current, low profile, and AEC Q101 options for
reliable performance across consumer, industrial, and automotive designs.

## MCC Products

Our portfolio contains five core discrete semiconductor types—offering a full range of diodes,
rectifiers, transistors, MOSFETs, voltage regulators and protection devices.

[MCC Diodes]

## [Diodes][137]
* Broad range of diodes: Zener, Schottky, FRED, Switching, and Small Signal Schottky
* Rectifier selection: Bridge, Standard Recovery, Fast Recovery, Super-Fast Recovery, and Schottky
  Barrier Rectifiers

[Transistors]

## [Bipolar Transistors][138]
* Small Signal and Power Transistors (BJTs)
* Pre-biased (Digital) Transistors
* Darlington and Matched Pair Transistors

[Protection Devices]

## [Protection Devices][139]
* Wide ESD port protection portfolio: USB, Ethernet, HDMI, RS-232, CAN/LIN, and more
* Diverse selection of 4,000+ Power TVS solutions

[MOSFETs]

## [MOSFETs][140]
* Wide range of Small Signal MOSFETs and Medium-High Power MOSFETs for selection
* Available in Split-Gate Technology, Trench Technology and Super Junction Technology to support
  various applications

[IGBT]

## [IGBT][141]
* Discrete IGBT products (up to 1200Vce and 75A) for operating frequencies of up to 40KHz
* IGBT Modules with high-current capability and excellent thermal performance

[ESD Protection and Power TVS]

## [Silicon Carbide (SiC)][142]
* SiC Schottky Barrier Diodes deliver low recovery losses due to low Cj for high-speed,
  high-voltage, and high-power density applications
* SiC MOSFETs provide low on-resistance and high switching frequency at operating temps up to 175°C

[IGBT]

## [Power Modules][143]
* Broad selection of total solutions in module type: FRED Modules, Standard Recovery Power Modules,
  and Thyristor Modules

[Voltage Regulators]

## [Voltage Regulators][144]
* Series and Shunt configurations are available
* Fixed (most popular voltage ratings) and Adjustable Positive/Negative Voltage Regulators

# Ihr Partner für Gleichstrom­versorgung

## mit Erfahrung seit über 55 Jahren

### High-Quality-Produkte

Seit über 55 Jahren steht MUNK weltweit für innovative und maßgeschneiderte
Gleichstromversorgung-Lösungen für industrielle Anwendungen.

Unsere Erfahrung und technische Kompetenz machen uns zu einem zuverlässigen Partner für
leistungsstarke und effiziente Gleichstromlösungen – ganz im Sinne unseres Anspruchs: „WE HAVE THE
POWER!“. Die Gleichstromversorgungen von MUNK decken ein breites Leistungsspektrum von 1 bis 100.000
Ampere ab und sind optimal für anspruchsvolle elektrochemische Prozesse ausgelegt.

Unsere Gleichstromversorgungssysteme kommen weltweit in vielfältigen Anwendungen zum Einsatz – von
der Rohstoffgewinnung über die Erzeugung von Prozess- und Reinstwasser bis hin zur
Oberflächenveredelung, Vergoldung sowie zum effektiven Korrosionsschutz im Automobilbau und bei
Landmaschinen. Dabei profitieren unsere Kunden von hoher Prozessstabilität und energieeffizientem
Betrieb. MUNK steht für zuverlässige Technologie, die selbst unter anspruchsvollen Bedingungen
dauerhaft höchste Leistung liefert.

# Ihr Partner für Gleichstrom­versorgung

## mit Erfahrung seit über 55 Jahren

### High-Quality-Produkte

Seit über 55 Jahren steht MUNK weltweit für innovative und maßgeschneiderte
Gleichstromversorgung-Lösungen für industrielle Anwendungen.

Unsere Erfahrung und technische Kompetenz machen uns zu einem zuverlässigen Partner für
leistungsstarke und effiziente Gleichstromlösungen – ganz im Sinne unseres Anspruchs: „WE HAVE THE
POWER!“. Die Gleichstromversorgungen von MUNK decken ein breites Leistungsspektrum von 1 bis 100.000
Ampere ab und sind optimal für anspruchsvolle elektrochemische Prozesse ausgelegt.

Unsere Gleichstromversorgungssysteme kommen weltweit in vielfältigen Anwendungen zum Einsatz – von
der Rohstoffgewinnung über die Erzeugung von Prozess- und Reinstwasser bis hin zur
Oberflächenveredelung, Vergoldung sowie zum effektiven Korrosionsschutz im Automobilbau und bei
Landmaschinen. Dabei profitieren unsere Kunden von hoher Prozessstabilität und energieeffizientem
Betrieb. MUNK steht für zuverlässige Technologie, die selbst unter anspruchsvollen Bedingungen
dauerhaft höchste Leistung liefert.

## We have the power!

Durch unsere Partner auf der ganzen Welt

Die MUNK-Gleichrichtertechnologie steht für Nachhaltigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und höchste Qualität.

 

Dank unserer langjährigen Erfahrung erfüllen unsere Stromversorgungslösungen die steigenden
Anforderungen an Effizienz und Energieeinsparung in modernen Industrieprozessen.

Mit einem starken internationalen Partnernetzwerk in Europa, China, Singapur, Australien, den USA
und Brasilien beliefern wir weltweit anspruchsvolle Kunden mit maßgeschneiderten
Stromversorgungslösungen.

 

Entwicklung und Produktion erfolgen dabei ausschließlich an unserem Hauptsitz in Deutschland: für
maximale Qualität und technologische Präzision.

## Added Benefits of Power Electronic Systems Supplied by Neeltran

At Neeltran (New Energy Transformer and Rectifiers) part of AMSC, we are uniquely positioned because
we are one of the few companies in the world that designs and manufactures its own industrial
rectifier transformers and DC rectifiers in the same facility under one management team. This unique
capability allows for combined Full Current and Full Voltage factory testing of the transformer and
rectifier in their actual configuration prior to shipment.

An experienced client requires combined testing to eliminate integration problems at the site and to
assure the shortest commissioning time. This results in significant cost savings and produces the
highest quality units. Most other Power Electronic System integrators purchase the Transformer from
the least expensive sub-contractor, or they manufacture key system components in different
geographic locations which operate under different management objectives. 

Our power conversion products and customer service are the best in the industry. Being that Neeltran
designs and builds its rectifiers and transformers you do not have to deal with a 3rd party for
service. Custom power systems manufacturing and engineering is what we do. Neeltran is ISO-9001-2015
certified.

We service our clients from installation to end of life of product, nobody beats our service as we
are on call for our customers and service many types of industrial rectifier systems (including
other brands). 

With Neeltran, your firm will gain access to our 45 plus years of proven Power Electronic
experience, the latest technology and professionals who are enjoying world-wide recognition in this
field. We offer a variaty of types of industrial rectifier products. We would welcome an opportunity
to work with you on your next project!

## Testimonials

**I have worked with NEELTRAN since Tony Capanna Sr. has bought the company....**


Eric A. Munzer, Senior Engineering Specialist, Consultant

# THE HOME OF NATIONAL TEAM FAN TOKENS™.

Back your nation with Fan Tokens™ and experience the tournament on Socios.com. Trade Fan Tokens™,
join matchday Token Hunts, compete with fellow fans and earn rewards throughout the tournament.

**Featuring official Fan Tokens™ from Argentina, Portugal, Belgium, South Africa and Scotland.**

[ Get Started ][29]
[ Download app ][30]

# the home of
# fan tokens.

Download the official Fan Token™ Wallet today! Hold, stake and trade Fan Tokens™, access Web3 sports
platforms & earn rewards from 70+ elite sports teams.
[Get Started][31] [Download app ][32]

## 70+ teams. 1 app.

The home of fan engagement and rewards for the world’s biggest teams.
[ Find your team ][33]

##  Your journey to incredible rewards

Transform your passion into rewards with officially licensed Fan Tokens.
Socios.com is a free-to-register Fan Engagement and Rewards app. But your journey ignites with Fan
Tokens. Get unprecedented access to your team, engage, earn points, and reward your passion with the
world’s best Fan Rewards. No renewal is required. 

## How it works

Join The Community
Register online, or download the app. Opening your Socios.com wallet takes just minutes.
Get Fan Tokens
Add Fan Tokens to your wallet. 
Engage
Use Fan Tokens to engage with the features on Socios.com and earn Reward Points. 
Redeem Rewards
Reward Points unlock the best fan rewards in the world.
[ Learn More ][34]

## The world’s best
## fan rewards

Watch a match alongside legends. Fly with the team on an away trip.
Score in iconic stadiums. Own game-scored balls and more (much more).
Premium
Access unmatched experiences that go beyond the pitch
Tickets
Get unparalleled access to major sporting events.
Merchandise
Gear up with authentic team merchandise.
Collectibles
Own Game-Scored Balls, Matchworn Shirts, Digital Collectibles, and More.

## Real Fans.
## Unreal Stories.

This is no fantasy game. Socios.com is real fans making a real impact and getting rewarded with
unreal experiences.
“Thank you Socios.com for my Ruben Dias signed shirt. I am absolutely thrilled.”

#### Bertie, UK

Man City Fan Token Holder
"It was the most special day of my life. I was so excited! Thank you Socios.com."

#### Nabe, Japan

AS Roma Fan Token Holder
"Still speechless after my “Live the dream” experience !!! Thank you socios.com. It has been
something that I’ll always bring in my heart!"

#### Fabrizio, Italy

AC Milan Fan Token Holder
"The last two days have been a dream. Still can't believe what I've experienced. It doesn't feel
real. Juventus doesn't come here often, but thanks to Socios.com, I was able to take this experience
to the next level. I'm forever thankful."

#### Martina, USA

Juventus Fan Token Holder
"Thank you for such a wonderful night. Result was unfortunate but it did not put me down. I had my
expectations high but they were still absolutely smashed. Red carpets, gold elevators, amazing food
and drinks, players families.. was truly a VIP experience."

#### Rian, Ireland

FC Barcelona Fan Token Holder
“This is the biggest benefit and I'm not talking just about the tickets. I saw my team become
Brazilian Champion for the first time in 50 years. There's no price on this opportunity I had thanks
to Socios.com"

#### Paulo, Brazil

Atletico Fan Token Holder

## Own Your Passion.

## Reap The Rewards.

platforms & earn rewards from 70+ elite sports teams.

## 70+ teams. 1 app.

The home of fan engagement and rewards for the world’s biggest teams.
[ Find your team ][33]

##  Your journey to incredible rewards

Transform your passion into rewards with officially licensed Fan Tokens.
Socios.com is a free-to-register Fan Engagement and Rewards app. But your journey ignites with Fan
Tokens. Get unprecedented access to your team, engage, earn points, and reward your passion with the
world’s best Fan Rewards. No renewal is required. 

## How it works

Join The Community
Register online, or download the app. Opening your Socios.com wallet takes just minutes.
Get Fan Tokens
Add Fan Tokens to your wallet. 
Engage
Use Fan Tokens to engage with the features on Socios.com and earn Reward Points. 
Redeem Rewards
Reward Points unlock the best fan rewards in the world.
[ Learn More ][34]

## The world’s best
## fan rewards

Watch a match alongside legends. Fly with the team on an away trip.
Score in iconic stadiums. Own game-scored balls and more (much more).
Premium
Access unmatched experiences that go beyond the pitch
Tickets
Get unparalleled access to major sporting events.
Merchandise

Collectibles

## Unreal Stories.

unreal experiences.

AS Roma Fan Token Holder

something that I’ll always bring in my heart!"

AC Milan Fan Token Holder
"The last two days have been a dream. Still can't believe what I've experienced. It doesn't feel
real. Juventus doesn't come here often, but thanks to Socios.com, I was able to take this experience
to the next level. I'm forever thankful."

"Thank you for such a wonderful night. Result was unfortunate but it did not put me down. I had my
expectations high but they were still absolutely smashed. Red carpets, gold elevators, amazing food
and drinks, players families.. was truly a VIP experience."

“This is the biggest benefit and I'm not talking just about the tickets. I saw my team become
